threat_event: Ransomware in DC1 encrypts the claims core and stops claims and ASO processing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Claims core shares the directory forest and data center zones with the HCIS
treatment_plan: Zone separation (group plan GR-01); claims core in the clean recovery design
owner: Health Plan security and compliance lead

threat_event: Hospital data received by the Health Plan exceeds the minimum necessary, or is used beyond its purpose
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written protocols for routine feeds

threat_event: The claims core cannot be restored in time from the vault
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Restore tested once a year; runbooks stored only on the claims share
treatment_plan: Runbooks copied to the vault and the offline binder; semiannual restore tests (POAM-018)
owner: Health Plan security and compliance lead

threat_event: Member data is stolen from Health Plan reporting shares on the group file service
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Reporting extracts kept on shares longer than needed
treatment_plan: Retention rule for extracts (30 days); egress alerting (GR-11 plan)
owner: Health Plan security and compliance lead

threat_event: The AI prior authorization triage pilot is moved into production without UM committee approval or individualized review
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot in shadow mode; not yet presented to the UM committee
existing_controls: Pilot cannot write decisions; physician review of adverse decisions
treatment_plan: UM committee review before any production use; P10 conditions

threat_event: Broker portal accounts are taken over through SMS code interception
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SMS codes still allowed for brokers
treatment_plan: App-based or phishing-resistant MFA for brokers by 2027-03-31
owner: Health Plan security and compliance lead

threat_event: A delegated UM or pharmacy benefit vendor has a breach of member data
treatment_plan: Security ratings monitoring for tier 1 delegated vendors (POAM-017)
owner: Health Plan security and compliance lead

threat_event: State insurance commissioner notices are missed in a cybersecurity event
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Commissioner contacts and 72-hour clocks not yet in the group matrix
treatment_plan: Add every adopting state's contact and clock to the matrix (POAM-005)

threat_event: Breach notices to self-funded employer plans are late under ASO BAAs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ASO BAA terms vary by employer
treatment_plan: Notice register by employer BAA term (P08)

threat_event: A claims vendor's remote access is misused
owner: Health Plan security and compliance lead

threat_event: A member portal configuration error exposes member data
owner: Health Plan security and compliance lead

threat_event: A hurricane closes the claims operations center
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 85% of claims staff can work remotely
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low by the Health Plan security and compliance lead
owner: Health Plan security and compliance lead

threat_event: Call center staff misuse member data
A fraudster changes a provider's bank account and diverts claims payments
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bank change requests by email and portal
treatment_plan: Verification through the provider portal only

threat_event: An access review lapse becomes an exception in the SOC 1 report
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Quarterly reviews completed late twice in 2025

threat_event: A caller impersonates a member to obtain PHI
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Verification by date of birth and member ID
treatment_plan: One-time code to the registered phone before disclosure
